teuh: Tewj — cold; teu 'cold' written with a final h, in the name Teuh Ha 'the Cold House', a house of trial (Tewj Ja)
zacbocom: saqb'okom — (?) hail, after Brasseur 'glace'; not otherwise known: zac 'white' + bocom (unknown); respelled by the letters
ochoch: ochoch — home, house; u ochoch 'its home', noun with u- 'its'
ꜩah: tzaj — (doubtful reading, guess) dry up, cease, abate (of the cold); after Brasseur 'le froid cessa promptement'; respelled by the letters
cuꜩ: kutz — (?) not understood; read with Brasseur's cutz as 'pine cones' in cuꜩ mamai na; respelled by the letters
mamai: mamai — (?) not understood; division mamai na doubtful, read with Brasseur as part of 'pine cones'; respelled by the letters
xzach: xsach — was lost, came to nothing; x- completive + sach 'lose, come to nothing', with no doer named
quꜩ: kutz — (?) well, in good state, in quꜩ qui vach 'their faces (were) well'; written with qu + the ligature, where Brasseur reads c'utz (ca vꜩ 'good'); respelled by the letters
pacaquic: pakakik — (doubtful reading, guess) fall upon, pounce on; verb in -ik (que pacaquic 'they fell upon (the bones)'), after Brasseur 'se jetèrent avec voracité'; respelled by the letters
vꜩinic: utzinik — be finished, done for; utz 'good, complete' + -in + -ik (cf. koj utzin 'we are done for')
catic: katik — (inferred) burn, be burned; taken as the verb k'at 'burn' with plain c, + -ik (xe katik 'they were burned', Brasseur 'embrasés'); respelled by the letters
bolol: b'olol — (?) blazing, a roar of flame; not otherwise known, paired with tzimaj, each with xa 'only'; respelled by the letters
ꜩimah: tzimaj — (?) roaring, crackling; not otherwise known, paired with b'olol, each with xa 'only'; respelled by the letters
cahauaxic: kajawaxik — (inferred) it is wanted; k- 'ongoing' + aj 'want' + -awax passive + -ik
zoꜩin: Sotz'in — Sotz'in, the Bat House (Sotz'in Ja); sotz' 'bat' + -in, name of a house of trial, the tz' supplied since the word is certain
zoꜩ: sotz' — bat; noun, the tz' supplied since the word is certain (the ligature after z); also within Kamasotz'
camazoꜩ: Kamasotz' — Camazotz, the bat lord; name, holding sotz' 'bat'; kama not certain (Brasseur 'qui prend ou commande les chauves-souris')
chaquiꜩam: Chakitzam — Chaquitzam, a name kept as written; chaqui 'dry' + tzam 'tip' after Brasseur 'pointe séchée' (?)
camizabal: kamisab'al — killing-instrument, instrument of death; kam 'die' + -is 'make' + -ab'al, ending of means (ki kamisab'al 'their instruments of death')
chopor: chopor — (?) meaning not known; the manuscript is clear (Brasseur has chupan); respelled by the letters and left out of the English
vcutbal: uk'utb'al — its showing, its showing itself; u- 'its' + k'ut 'show' + -b'al, ending of means (uk'utb'al rib' 'its showing itself') (inferred)
buhuhic: b'ujujik — (guess) whirring, making a great noise; not otherwise known, perhaps a sound word, verb in -ik (que buhuhic, of the bats; Brasseur 'faisant un grand bruit'); respelled by the letters
quiliꜩ: kilitz — Kilitz, the bats' cry 'quilitz'; imitative word, kept as written
xtane: xtane — it stopped; x- completive + tane 'stop, cease' (inferred), cf. tanenik
zilobic: silob'ik — stirring, moving; sil 'move, stir' + -ob' + -ik, as ke silob'ik 'they stir'
chacal: chakal — (?) standing, perched; not otherwise known, after Brasseur 'elles restèrent debout'; respelled by the letters
cahanic: kajanik — (?) beginning, starting; not otherwise known (cahanic pa usaqirik 'is it beginning to dawn'); respelled by the letters
cahanican: kajanikan — (?) perhaps beginning; a doubtful reading, kajanik + -an, not otherwise known (Brasseur 'Peut-être commence-t-il'); respelled by the letters
labalo: lab'alo — (?) perhaps; not otherwise known, a doubtful reading; respelled by the letters
mucum: mukum — (inferred) peering, looking out; perhaps the muc 'look' of earlier parts (Brasseur 'regarder à la bouche de sa sarbacane'); respelled by the letters
ril: ril — he sees it; r- 'he, it' + il 'see'
cupul: kupul — (inferred) cut off; same root as kupix 'cut off'; respelled by the letters
huchatic: juchatik — (?) again, once more; a doubtful reading (the ß-like ligature read ti), after Brasseur 'Puis une autre fois'; respelled by the letters
zilabic: silab'ik — (?) stirring; doubtful reading, a variant of silob'ik; respelled by the letters
zoz: sos — (?) lying sprawled; doubtful reading, perhaps zoꜩ written with a tail on the z; respelled by the letters, in k'o sos 'there is lying'
quixbih: kixb'ij — (?) shame; xu kixb'ij 'it shamed (him)', not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
acaroc: akarok — alas; a cry of grief (Brasseur 'Hélas!'), interjection
yayan: yayan — (?) undone, ruined; not otherwise known (mi xqa yayan 'we are undone'); respelled by the letters
colana: kolana — (?) to be set, put in place; not otherwise known (xb'e kolana wi 'it went to be set there'); respelled by the letters
ac: ak — (?) peccary, after Brasseur 'Sangliers'; perhaps aꜫ 'peccary' (aq') written with plain c, as it stands beside ziz in the same kind of list; respelled by the letters
xare: xare — just so, only this; xa 'only' + are 'this' run together (xawi xare 'just so'), after Brasseur xavixare
racabal: raq'ab'al — its night, at night; r- 'its' + aq'ab' 'night' + -al
cumar: kumar — (?) rotten, decayed; after Brasseur 'ce qui était en putréfaction', a guess; respelled by the letters
ꜩalic: tzalik — (?) grasses; not otherwise known (k'o xa tzalik 'there are only tzalik'); respelled by the letters
canohoc: kanojok — (?) left behind; from kanoq 'left behind' (inferred); respelled by the letters
tiz: tis — (?) meaning not known; doubtful reading (ligature and z retouched), read with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
cubulcutih: kub'ulkutij — (?) waddling; doubtful reading (the MS looks like cubulcahh), read with Brasseur; respelled by the letters
chuꜩam: chutzam — at its tip, at its end; chi + u- 'its' + tzam 'tip'
halvachibal: jalwachib'al — likeness, a changed face; jal 'change' + wach 'face' + -ib'al, ending of means (inferred)
xcotix: xkotix — (?) was carved; perhaps the root of modern k'ot 'carve', plain c, + -ix passive (inferred)
coloc: kolok — (?) hovering, came hovering; not otherwise known, after Brasseur 'vint planer'; paired with kulok; respelled by the letters
xulu: xulu — (doubtful reading) came, arrived; x- completive + ul 'come, arrive' + -u (the MS looks like xuh), read with Brasseur's x'ulu; paired with xul (xul coloc, xulu culoc); respelled by the letters
culoc: kulok — (?) came down; not otherwise known, doubtful reading, paired with kolok; respelled by the letters
zoꜩi: Sotz'i — Sotz'i, the Bat House (Sotz'i Ja), a form of Sotz'in Ja; sotz' 'bat' + -i, name of a house
atan: atan — (?) quickly, soon; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
chuuc: chuuk — (?) its hair; doubtful reading (n or u); u chuuk, with u- 'its'; respelled by the letters
hebel: jeb'el — (inferred) fine, handsome; perhaps the modern jeb'el 'pretty' (u chuuk jeb'el 'its hair fine'); the letters respelled
cactarin: kaktarin — (?) reddening; probably cac 'red' (kaq) + -tar + -in, not otherwise known (Brasseur 'l'aurore colorait l'horizon'); respelled by the letters
xecah: xekaj — foot of the sky, the horizon; xe' 'foot, root' + kaj 'sky'; u xekaj 'its foot of the sky'
xaquinuchic: xakinuchik — (?) spreading the legs; not otherwise known, one word of a kind not met before, read from Brasseur's note; respelled by the letters
ama: ama — (?) question particle; not otherwise known (Ama xuchux ri wuch' 'has the opossum done it?'), a guess; respelled by the letters
xuchux: xuchux — (?) it has been done, made; x-u- + chux 'become, be made', after Brasseur's note (inferred)
xaquinic: xakinik — (?) spreading the legs; xakin 'spread the legs' + -ik (inferred, after Brasseur); respelled by the letters
queꜫumar: q'equmar — grow dark; q'equm 'darkness' + -ar, as xq'equmarik (ta chi q'equmar chik 'then it grew dark again')
xaquin: xakin — (?) spread the legs; the root of xakinik (inferred, after Brasseur), as in xakin ri mama 'the old man spread his legs'; respelled by the letters
raxaꜩinic: raxatzinik — (?) blue-green, being blue-green; rax 'green, blue' + -atzinik (not otherwise known); respelled by the letters
ꜭohic: k'ojik — being, existence; k'oj (as k'oje 'be, be there') + -ik (u k'ojik 'its being')
chux: chux — it shall be, will do; ch- + ux 'become'
baquitila: b'akitila — (?) shaped, given its shape; not otherwise known (chu b'akitila u jolom 'he shaped his head'); respelled by the letters
chayecuh: chayekuj — (?) you expose, show yourself; ch- + a- 'you' + yekuj, doubtful reading and not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
ꜭoleta: k'oleta — (?) go and be placed, go and settle; k'ol 'be (put) in a place', as k'olik, + -eta, an ending not met before (kat k'oleta 'go and settle yourself'); respelled by the letters
pixc: pixk — (?) pix, kept in K'iche' (perhaps the tomato, or acorns after Brasseur 'glands'); not clear; respelled by the letters
avuꜭ: awuk' — with you; a- 'your' + wuk' 'with', preposition
xpixabaxic: xpixab'axik — he was charged, was given orders; x- completive + pixab' 'charge, advise' + -ax passive + -ik
colan: kolan — (?) hanging, set; the kolana of the earlier line (inferred); respelled by the letters
chacoyan: chakoyan — (?) have won; chak 'win, defeat' + -oyan, an ending not met before (inferred)
yan: yan — (?) meaning not known; not otherwise known (b'ano ki yan 'did their yan'); respelled by the letters
chacuca: chakuka — (doubtful reading, guess) not understood; read 'let (the head) rest' after Brasseur 'Repose ta tête'; respelled by the letters
caxou: kaxow — (?) it pained, hurt; doubtful reading (n or u, decided with Brasseur); respelled by the letters
yecoub: yekowb' — (guess) hold back, restrain (oneself), in chi yecoub quib; not otherwise known, perhaps the yecuh of chayecuh; plain c kept where Brasseur has g; respelled by the letters
xeꜩacou: xetzakow — (inferred) they threw, it was they who threw; x- completive + e 'they' + tzak 'throw, strike' + -ow, the ending that names the doers (after Are); respelled by the letters
xicou: xik'ow — it passed; x- completive + ik'ow 'pass'
canab: kanab' — (?) a bound, a leap; doubtful reading, noun in xa jun xa kanab' wi 'in one bound'; respelled by the letters
pix: pix — (?) pix, kept in K'iche' (perhaps the tomato, or acorns after Brasseur 'glands'); not clear
coxcotic: koxkotik — (inferred) hopping; a doubled root painting a movement (cf. tzotzotik), chi koxkotik 'hopping'; the t is the looped t
ocotal: okotal — (?) chased; from okot 'chase' (after Brasseur 'poursuivi'), inferred
chaninic: chaninik — (?) hurrying, rushing; perhaps from chanim 'quickly'; ke chaninik 'they hurried'
camixtah: kamixtaj — (?) snatched, took quickly; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
xtiquixtah: xtikixtaj — (?) planted, set again; doubtful reading (the h-like t read as i), perhaps from tikib'a' 'plant, begin'; respelled by the letters
cuba: kub'a — (?) set down, placed; after Brasseur 'colloquer', inferred; respelled by the letters
ꜩucu: tzuku — look for, seek; tzukuj 'look for' without its final j; a doubtful reading (Brasseur tzuku)
colem: kolem — (?) holding up, raising; not otherwise known (ki kolem 'their raising'); respelled by the letters
xcacatah: xkakataj — (?) was struck; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
pucabin: pukab'in — (?) shattered, broken apart; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
zaquiram: saqiram — (?) scattered; perhaps from saq 'white'; not otherwise known; respelled by the letters
zaquilal: saqilal — its whiteness; saq 'white' + -il + -al, with u- 'its'
rahal: rajal — (?) lords; doubtful reading, the draft follows Brasseur's r'ahaual 'its lords', a dropped syllable possible; respelled by the letters
cohe: k'oje — be, be there; ꜭohe 'be' written with plain c (Brasseur qohe), the k' restored as in coheic (xe k'oje wi 'they were there')
